corpus.purpose: Tokenizer-research corpus foundation (Project 004 Stage A). No tokenizer has been selected here, and nothing in this corpus selects one.

targets.note: Targets from the Project 004 design audit. They are goals, not quotas: a slot below target is reported as INSUFFICIENT with the real amount, never padded.

split.note: Each document is assigned by sha256('<seed>:<doc_id>') < heldout_fraction. No global RNG, so the split is reproducible and independent of document order.

cleaning_policy: prepare_source_text (kind-specific wrapper/markup removal only: Gutenberg header/footer, wikitext markup). Unicode normalization is NOT applied; NFC/NFD/NFKC experiments belong to a later Project 004 stage.

sources.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
sources.attribution: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll, text from Project Gutenberg (ebook 11). Public domain in the United States; verify local copyright terms before use elsewhere. Used here as a tokenizer-research fixture, not as a redistribution.
sources.notes: English slot. The Gutenberg header/footer is stripped by clean_gutenberg_text(); the licence is recorded in the provenance file. Hash is pinned only after a verified fetch.

sources.title: गोदान (Godaan) — Munshi Premchand
sources.attribution: Hindi Wikisource contributors, गोदान (Godaan) by Munshi Premchand, via hi.wikisource.org, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (assumed conservatively until the page's own licence tag is checked on first fetch).
sources.notes: Hindi slot, Devanagari. Verify the page title and its licence tag on first fetch; if the page carries a PD template the licence_id may be relaxed to PD-US with a note.

license_evidence.note: The `?action=raw` payload is bare wikitext and does not contain the CC BY-SA notice, so the wiki's own machine-readable rights declaration (Meta siteinfo rightsinfo) is fetched as separate evidence. This is SITE-level evidence: it proves hi.wikisource.org publishes under CC BY-SA 4.0, not that this specific page carries that tag. The page-level tag still has to be reviewed by a human and recorded before the slot is trusted for redistribution.

sources.title: গীতাঞ্জলি (Gitanjali) — Rabindranath Tagore
sources.attribution: Bengali Wikisource contributors, গীতাঞ্জলি (Gitanjali) by Rabindranath Tagore, via bn.wikisource.org, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (assumed conservatively until the page's own licence tag is checked on first fetch).
sources.notes: Bengali slot. The author died in 1941 and the work is public domain in India, but the edition on Wikisource may carry its own tag; check it on first fetch and record what you find.

license_evidence.note: Site-level evidence for bn.wikisource.org, fetched separately from the wikitext payload (which carries no licence notice). Page-level review of the edition's own licence tag is still required; see the source notes.

notes: Every source keeps sha256=null and verified=false until it has actually been fetched and its licence has been proven by a recorded mechanism (a marker in the payload, or a declared licence-evidence endpoint whose result is stored verbatim). Nothing here is asserted from memory; a hash is never treated as proof of licensing. A language slot is only counted as EVALUATED when it has verified sources meeting the targets.
